PAPER
Design system, brand v1

One page for how kaibo looks and moves

The reference for how the app looks and moves (issue #296, 17 Nov 2026). It replaces the v3 "night" design-system board. Every colour on this page is read from tokens_v1.css, every ratio from contrast_v1.md, and the logo from Design's own files. Sample names and numbers are invented.

ColourTypeSpacing and shapeThe glow ComponentsLogoCompany tileMotionContrastThe app today

Decided by Product on 18 Nov 2026 (#307): the type steps are 17 / 15 / 13; the company tile is signed off as built; and the motion rule is "no data motion loops", with two loops allowed (skeletons breathe, the live dot pulses). This page shows all three.

Colour

Three values come straight from the logo: blue #4F95F0, white #F4F5F7, black #0A0B0D. Blue is kept for four things: the logo, the one primary action on a screen, links and focus, and the live point. Dark is the theme the app runs; light is defined and off.

Type

Outfit for everything, numbers too, with tabular figures on. Weights: 400 text, 500 status rows, 600 headings and buttons, 700 the hero figure and titles. Body, small and caption are 17 / 15 / 13 (one step larger since #294, confirmed in #307). Nothing below 12 px. Body text gets word-spacing: 0.06em.

The point
--point 8px, 10 px at the end of the chart line, 6 px above the active tab. The one live indicator. When the engine is stale or stopped it is not shown; a status row says so in words.
Focus
2 px --focus ring, 2 px offset, on every control, in both themes.

The glow

Every page stands on one light: a radial glow of --sea-tint fading into --paper, 110% by 70% of the screen, with a faint noise so the fade does not band. It is one layer fixed to the screen, so it never scrolls or repeats. Cards, rows and sheets stay opaque on top of it. This page stands on it, anchored top right as Home is.

Sign-in: bottom left
Home: top right. Positions, Activity, Engine and More sit a little off it.

Components

Each one in its four states. Narrow the window to phone width (under 761 px) and the same page shows the phone layout. The label on each state says where it comes from: rule is written in a design document, as built is how the app does it today with no written rule, follows is this page applying a written rule to a case no document names. The last two need Design's sign-off. The company tile was "as built" until it was signed off in #307; its rule is now in brand_system_v1.md, section 5.

Defaultrule

The wordmark alone in the header and on sign-in; the k alone where space is short. The files are used unchanged.

Loadingrule

Skeleton

Defaultrule

Raised-surface bars (--surface-2), row-shaped, 8 px corners, an opacity breathe: 1 to 0.55 and back every 1.6 s. No blue.

Loadingrule
with reduce motion

It is the loading state. It may loop, because it carries no data. With reduce motion the bars stand still.

Logo

The Rising k. The k's blue arm is the pot's line and the blue point sits on the i. The header, sign-in and New run show the wordmark alone.

Clear space

The dashed box is the edge of the wordmark file itself. Design's files carry their own margin: 14 units on every side of the wordmark, where the stem is 15 units wide and the letters 88 tall, so the clear space is about one stem (logo/gen/build.py, pad=14; the symbol sits in a 120-unit square). Keep text, edges and other marks outside that box. No document states a clear-space rule or a smallest size in words yet: that is a finding for Design, listed under The app today.

Company tile

Wherever a stock is named: a squircle (a superellipse, n = 5, the curve of an app icon) with the company's logo on a colour sampled from that logo (grey 50 when none was sampled), or the ticker's initials. A hairline, white at 8%, follows the same curve so the tile keeps its edge on the glow. Signed off as built (#307); the rule is in brand_system_v1.md, section 5.

KBODEMKBODEMO
Sizes given: 32 (stacked faces on a theme card), 36 (rows, lists, tables), 40 (position and activity rows), 52 (a holding's own page). Each is drawn 8% larger (35, 39, 43, 56 px; #293, stakeholder, 17 Nov 2026). The logo keeps the padding sampled for it (12% until sampled). Initials: three or four letters, bold, never under 12 px, on one of ten dark tints picked by the ticker. The round mark here stands in for a company's logo; no real logo is used on this page.

Motion

The logo's load animation as a family: things rise, lines draw, the point pops. No data motion loops: what shows data plays once. Two signals may loop, because they say "loading" or "live" and carry no data; both stop with reduce motion.

A row risesa line draws, the point pops and pulses once
The two loops
a skeleton breathes, 1.6 s; the live dot pulses, 2 s
With reduce motion
both stand still
Things riseSheets and rows: 320 ms in, 240 ms out (--d-sheet). Height never animates.
Lines draw--d-draw 300ms: the chart line on first load, as the logo's arm does.
The point pops--d-point 180ms with --ease-pop cubic-bezier(.3, 1.4, .5, 1); it pulses once when a new value arrives.
Easingcubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1) for everything entering; cubic-bezier(.4, 0, 1, 1) for everything leaving.
Press and select120 ms (--d-fast). Fades, colour changes and the number tick: 200 ms (--d-base).
Tab changeContent cross-fades in 200 ms with a 4 px rise. The top bar and the tab bar do not move.
The glowDrifts with a transform only: 900 ms from sign-in to Home, 600 ms between tabs, the house easing.
The logoOnce per app load, under a second: the stem rises, the leg sets, the arm draws, the point appears with one soft pulse.
What may moveOnly transform and opacity.
No data motion loopsAnything that shows data plays once: a chart draws once, a point pops once, a number ticks once. Nothing else loops except the two signals below.
Loop: skeletons breatheOpacity 1 to 0.55 and back every 1.6 s (kb-breathe). No shimmer: it animates background-position, which repaints every frame.
Loop: the live dot pulsesA ring grows from the dot and fades every 2 s (kb-pulse), only while the engine is live.
Reduce motionNo draw, no pop, no pulse; values just change; the glow jumps; the finished logo shows at once. Both loops stop: skeletons stand still and the live dot shows without its ring.

Contrast

Ratios are WCAG 2, taken from contrast_v1.md. Text needs 4.5:1; large text and the parts of a control need 3:1. Nothing is changed by this page; what does not hold is listed.

Findings

  • No measured pair is below WCAG AA. contrast_v1.md holds 96 pairs (48 dark, 48 light); every one meets its line.
  • Narrow passes (within 10% of the line; do not darken or lighten these without measuring): chart: loss mark on a card, dark, 3.01:1 of 3:1; primary button: label on blue, light, 4.72:1 of 4.5:1; third-level text on a raised surface, light, 4.78:1 of 4.5:1.
  • Not in contrast_v1.md: text standing on the glow (brand_system_v1.md section 8 says it passes at the brightest point, without a number) and the initials on the company tile's ten tints. Measured for this page: text on the glow's brightest point 15.09:1; second-level text on the glow's brightest point 9.49:1; third-level text on the glow's brightest point 7.30:1; initials on the lightest of the ten tile tints 10.54:1. None is below its line. They should become rows of the file.
  • Not measured anywhere: the tile's hairline (white at 8%), a company's own logo on its own sampled colour, and disabled controls at 45% opacity (WCAG does not set a minimum for inactive controls). The hairline --rule is decoration by rule and nothing relies on it.
  • The logo's blue on a light page: #4F95F0 on #F4F5F7 is 2.79:1 (logo_concepts.md), below 3:1. That is why the light files use #2F6FDE (4.33:1). Never place the dark-background logo on a light surface.

Nothing in the app was changed. The colours, the font, the focus ring, the tab bar, the filter chips, the experiment's lab note and the glow already match.
